prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores 83 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: the share price is 16.3% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 18.1 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. prose.against: The case against rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow for the last financial year was negative: the business spent more than it generated. Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, the quality of the business.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 7 points in favour and 7 against give an even split. The pool score is 35 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend.
